hints.content: Let's solve for $z$. Remember that it is not possible to have a negative side length!
The side length of the cube is $6 \text{ cm}$.

question.content:
A cube with side length $z$ has a volume of $216$ cubic centimeters. The following equation shows the volume of the cube.

$z^3 = 216$

**What is the side length of the cube in centimeters?**

[[☃ numeric-input 1]]
